Hi Laura,

We're wrapping up NovusBank's SIG review and I have a couple of follow ups specific to BCP/DR. Can you help us with the following items by next week?

- A short attestation of your RTO/RPO commitments for the hosted inference service (preferably a table we can attach to the SIG response).
- The most recent recovery runbook(s) that cover regional failover and warm-cache procedures for model serving (we only need the operational appendix; redacted secrets are fine).
- Evidence from your latest DR exercise (logs or a short recording) plus a short summary of lessons learned.
- KV-cache warm timings (how long to reach steady-state after failover) and any observed variance.
- A named witness (engineer or PM) who can join a 45–60 minute tabletop/witness session to walk through the runbook and answer questions. Our windows: Tue 14 Oct 10:00–11:00 PT or Thu 16 Oct 13:00–14:00 PT.

Can you confirm what you can provide and whether either of those witness windows works? If you already have artifacts, please attach them (runbook, RTO/RPO matrix, exercise logs).

Thanks — Sophie

Hi Sophie — thanks for the clear list. We can provide a compact evidence bundle and nominate a witness for the tabletop. Quick answers up front:

- Witness availability: Tue 14 Oct 10:00–11:00 PT works for us; we'll provision both an engineer and an SRE lead.
- Artifacts: we'll attach the operational runbook appendix (runbook_v2.pdf) and an RTO/RPO matrix (rto_rpo_matrix.xlsx).
- RTO/RPO summary (high level): regional failover RTO: ~15 minutes for control-plane rehydration and routing; serving-level warm-steady-state (RTO to full perf) ~20–30 minutes in worst-case cold-starts. RPO for user-facing inference state is target <60s for ephemeral KV snapshots; for persisted tenant metadata RPO is near-zero (replicated stores). We'll put exact numbers in the matrix.

Ben and Priyom are copied — Ben will pull KV warm timing logs and Priyom will attach the most recent DR exercise recording and a short narrative.

I'll share a Drive folder with the package and send a calendar invite for the 14 Oct witness slot once we confirm.

Laura — quick technical note for the bundle: the KV warm times vary by model size and region. I pulled the traces from the last DR test (attached) — see kv-warm-times.csv for per-region median and 95th percentile times. Highlights:

- Median steady-state (inference throughput restored) after cache restore: 4.2 minutes (us-west-2), 5.6 minutes (eu-west-1).
